text:
```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run type check
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Run linting
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build project (preview-only)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Upload artifacts (preview-only)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-artifacts
          path: dist/
```
